knowledge:
- key_parameters: sim_size=A numeric vector or single integer specifying the number of cells to simulate ;; est_Paras=Parameter estimation object generated by Est2Phase from template data ;; per_DE=Percentage of genes to be perturbed as differentially expressed (DE) genes ;; DE_Method=Method used for differential expression analysis (e.g., "MAST") ;; Cell_Type=Comparison scenario type (e.g., "PW" for pairwise) ;; multiProb=Numeric vector of cell type proportions for multi-group simulation
- alternatives: Other state-of-the-art simulators (unnamed in the text) which POWSC outperforms in capturing key characteristics of real datasets, and traditional microarray/bulk RNA-seq sample size calculation methods (not suitable for scRNA-seq due to sparsity and heterogeneity)
- when_to_use: At the experimental design stage of a single-cell RNA-seq study to determine the required sample size (number of cells) and sequencing depth for adequate power to detect DE genes, for both within-cell-type and between-cell-type comparisons
- pitfalls: Using too small of a sample size for multi-group comparisons (the docs note "use a large sample is preferrable" for sim_size in multiple-group comparisons); failing to account for cell type proportions in multi-group comparisons, which heavily impacts DE power

workflows.name: two_group_power_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform power and sample size analysis for a two-group comparison (within cell type) using pilot/template scRNA-seq data
input: pilot_data.rds (SingleCellExperiment object containing pilot/template scRNA-seq data)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter template data for a specific cell type ;; 2. Estimate parameters using Est2Phase ;; 3. Simulate two-group SingleCellExperiment datasets using Simulate2SCE ;; 4. Run differential expression analysis using runDE ;; 5. Evaluate discrete and continuous power using Power_Disc and Power_Cont
workflows.code:
sce = es_mef_sce[, colData(es_mef_sce)$cellTypes == "fibro"]
set.seed(12)
rix = sample(1:nrow(sce), 500)
sce = sce[rix, ]
est_Paras = Est2Phase(sce)
simData = Simulate2SCE(n=100, estParas1 = est_Paras, estParas2 = est_Paras)
de = runDE(simData$sce, DE_Method = "MAST")
estPower1 = Power_Disc(de, simData = simData)
estPower2 = Power_Cont(de, simData = simData)

workflows.name: multiple_group_power_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform power and sample size analysis for multiple-group comparisons (between cell types) using pilot/template scRNA-seq data with multiple cell types and patient/sample metadata
input: multi_cell_pilot_data.rds (SingleCellExperiment object containing pilot/template scRNA-seq data with multiple cell types and patient/sample metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Extract expression matrix and metadata ;; 2. Estimate parameters for each cell type using Est2Phase ;; 3. Simulate multiple-group SingleCellExperiment datasets using SimulateMultiSCEs with specified cell type proportions ;; 4. Run pairwise differential expression analysis using runDE ;; 5. Evaluate discrete and continuous power for each comparison using Power_Disc and Power_Cont ;; 6. Visualize power results using a heatmap
workflows.code:
data("GSE67835_AB_S7_sce")
sim_size = 200 # use a large sample is preferrable
cell_per = c(0.2, 0.3, 0.5)
col = colData(sce)
exprs = assays(sce)$counts
(tb = table(colData(sce)$Patients, colData(sce)$cellTypes))
# use AB_S7 patient as example and take three cell types: astrocytes hybrid and neurons
estParas_set = NULL
celltypes = c("oligodendrocytes", "hybrid", "neurons")
for (cp in celltypes){
    print(cp)
    ix = intersect(grep(cp, col$cellTypes), grep("AB_S7", col$Patients))
    tmp_mat = exprs[, ix]
    tmp_paras = Est2Phase(tmp_mat)
    estParas_set[[cp]] = tmp_paras
}
sim = SimulateMultiSCEs(n = sim_size, estParas_set = estParas_set, multiProb = cell_per)
DE_rslt = NULL
for (comp in names(sim)){
    tmp = runDE(sim[[comp]]$sce, DE_Method = "MAST")
    DE_rslt[[comp]] = tmp
}
pow_rslt = pow1 = pow2 = pow1_marg = pow2_marg = NULL
TD = CD = NULL
for (comp in names(sim)){
    tmp1 = Power_Disc(DE_rslt[[comp]], sim[[comp]])
    tmp2 = Power_Cont(DE_rslt[[comp]], sim[[comp]])
    TD = c(TD, tmp2$TD); CD = c(CD, tmp2$CD)
    pow1_marg = c(pow1_marg, tmp1$power.marginal)
    pow2_marg = c(pow2_marg, tmp2$power.marginal)
    pow_rslt[[comp]] = list(pow1 = tmp1, pow2 = tmp2)
    pow1 = rbind(pow1, tmp1$power)
    pow2 = rbind(pow2, tmp2$power)
}
library(RColorBrewer); library(pheatmap)
breaksList = seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)
colors = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdYlBu")))(length(breaksList))
dimnames(pow1) = list(names(sim), names(tmp1$CD))
dimnames(pow2) = list(names(sim), names(tmp2$CD))
pheatmap(pow2, display_numbers = TRUE, color=colors, show_rownames = TRUE,
         cellwidth = 30, cellheight = 40, legend = TRUE,
         border_color = "grey96", na_col = "grey",
         cluster_row = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.01),
         main = "")
